title: Null Acceptance
description: Distinguishes an optional parameter that may be omitted from a parameter that explicitly accepts null.
question: Does adaptation preserve whether each parameter accepts null?
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP tool schemas distinguishing omission from null.
known_issues: Two framework adapters could not be measured against 2026-07-28, so missing evidence is not a support result.
why: Optional and nullable are different contracts. Conflating them lets a downstream caller express values the source never accepted.
